# Deal Notes

> Buying guides and deal-event help for Amazon shoppers. Picks come from published, test-based reviews (each linked); deal-event dates come from Amazon's own announcements. No scraped prices or ratings.

## Buying guides
- [Kitchen gear worth buying on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/guides/kitchen/): Five kitchen basics with long track records in independent testing: a chef's knife, cast-iron skillet, instant-read thermometer and kitchen scale. How we chose and what to check.
- [Home office gear worth buying on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/guides/home-office/): Webcam, wireless keyboard, mechanical keyboard and mouse picks for a home office, chosen from current test-based reviews. No fake testing, no scraped prices.
- [Tech accessories worth buying on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/guides/tech-accessories/): USB-C charger, cable, power bank and e-reader picks from current test-based reviews, plus how to avoid unsafe no-name chargers. Check live prices on Amazon.
- [Starter tools worth buying on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/guides/tools/): A cordless drill, drill bit set and tape measure chosen from current test-based reviews, plus a ladder recall to check. Live prices on Amazon.
- [Outdoor gear worth buying on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/guides/outdoor/): Headlamp, water bottle, cooler and camp chair picks for camping and day trips, chosen from current test-based reviews. How we chose, what to check, live prices on Amazon.
- [Gift ideas by recipient and budget](https://deals.samcbarth.com/guides/gifts/): Holiday gift ideas sorted by who you are shopping for and rough budget band, drawn from our test-backed buying guides. Includes Amazon's 2026 holiday return window.

## Deal events
- [Amazon Black Friday 2026: what Amazon has confirmed](https://deals.samcbarth.com/deal-events/black-friday/): Black Friday 2026 is November 27 and Cyber Monday is November 30, per Amazon. What Amazon has and has not announced, the holiday return window, and how to shop it well.
- [Amazon Cyber Monday 2026: date and shopping tips](https://deals.samcbarth.com/deal-events/cyber-monday/): Cyber Monday 2026 is November 30, per Amazon. What Amazon has confirmed, how it relates to Black Friday, the holiday return window and how to judge a deal.
- [Amazon Prime Day 2026: dates, rules and what comes next](https://deals.samcbarth.com/deal-events/prime-day/): Prime Day 2026 ran June 23 to 26 and Prime Big Deal Days ran October 6 to 7, per Amazon. Who can shop, which countries, and how to prepare for the next one.
- [Back-to-school shopping on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/deal-events/back-to-school/): Amazon folded early back-to-school shopping into Prime Day 2026 (June 23 to 26). Student Prime pricing, where Amazon's back-to-school pages live, and what to buy.

## Explainers
- [How to spot a real deal on Amazon](https://deals.samcbarth.com/how-to-spot-a-real-deal/): A real deal is a price below what the item usually sells for, not below an inflated list price. Seven quick checks for Amazon sales, from price history to seller names.
- [Amazon price history, explained](https://deals.samcbarth.com/price-history/): Price history shows what an item really sold for over time, which is the best way to judge a sale. How to check it with Amazon's own tools and third-party trackers, and how to read the chart.
